# IOC Extractor 0.2.1

Version 0.2.1 is a security maintenance release for installations running
0.2.0. It updates the runtime dependency stack while preserving the 0.2.x
configuration, storage and artifact contracts.

## Highlights

- Updated Spring and Tomcat dependencies address known framework and HTTP
  container vulnerabilities.
- Updated document parsing dependencies address the Tika ISA-Tab path traversal
  and jsoup custom-safelist sanitization advisories.
- Existing 0.2.0 installations retain their configuration and SQLite schemas.

## Added

Not applicable. This maintenance release adds no application capabilities.

## Changed

- Spring Boot 4.0.8 manages Spring Framework 7.0.9 and Spring Integration 7.0.6.
- Tomcat is explicitly managed at 11.0.25 and jsoup at 1.23.1 because the
  upstream Boot and Tika versions still select affected versions.
- Tika 3.3.2 uses the centrally aligned Commons IO 2.22.0, Bouncy Castle 1.85
  and PDFBox 3.0.8 families. Java 21 remains required.

## Fixed

- Updated Tomcat for the advisories fixed in 11.0.25, including
  CVE-2026-65182, CVE-2026-65905 and CVE-2026-68525.
- Updated Spring Framework and Integration for the affected 7.0.8 and 7.0.5
  dependency families reported by the repository security scan.
- Updated Tika for CVE-2026-66755 and jsoup for CVE-2026-71497.

## Upgrade notes

1. For a 0.2.0 installation, pause intake and synchronization and retain the
   application, configuration and both SQLite databases as one consistent
   backup before activating the replacement JAR.
2. Use the existing [0.2.x deployment procedure](https://github.com/xORex-LC/ioc-extractor/blob/v0.2.1/docs/guides/deployment.md).
   This patch introduces no configuration or database migration. Confirm health,
   extraction and delivery before resuming normal intake.
3. Installations still running 0.1.0 must follow the fresh side-by-side
   transition described in the [0.2.0 notes](https://github.com/xORex-LC/ioc-extractor/releases/tag/v0.2.0).

Rollback: the 0.2.x deployment procedure supports restoring the previous
application and matching configuration/database backup. Account for inputs
accepted after that backup. Returning to 0.2.0 also restores its affected
dependency versions. Installed-service upgrade and rollback checks were not
performed; the isolated compatibility checks are described below.

## Breaking or observable contract changes

No intentional changes to supported CLI, configuration, CSV/manifest, ECS or
storage contracts. Dependency security fixes may reject malformed inputs that
the previous dependency versions accepted.

## Known issues

- Document parsing still lacks a complete input/decompression/time budget
  (`SRC-2` in [KNOWN-ISSUES](https://github.com/xORex-LC/ioc-extractor/blob/v0.2.1/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md)); dependency updates do
  not establish a resource isolation boundary for hostile documents.

## Verification

- Local reactor verification passed in an isolated checkout: 21 Maven projects,
  171 suites, 781 tests, no failures/errors and two skipped tests. Packaging
  contracts, shell checks and offline documentation links passed.
- CLI, oneshot extraction/export and daemon ingest/health smoke checks passed.
- A checksum-verified published 0.2.0 JAR created representative SQLite state;
  0.2.1 preserved schemas, canonical rows/IDs and CSV bytes on duplicate input
  and accepted new rows. The old binary then read and wrote that state without
  schema changes or loss of canonical rows. Both database integrity checks passed.
- [Dependency-Check run 34347016104](https://github.com/xORex-LC/ioc-extractor/actions/runs/34347016104)
  passed on candidate commit `7694dc1e4152953fa41ef417017e30db1e73c3d1`.
  Its NVD cache was refreshed on 2026-09-09 at 11:51 UTC; the report contains
  128 dependencies and no unsuppressed findings. The two existing JBIG2
  false-positive suppressions remain in use; the unused-rule gate passed.
  Artifact: `dependency-check-report-14` (ID `10102398102`).
- All PR CI jobs passed for that candidate. Any later release commit must also
  pass its exact-commit security gate before tagging. Default-branch Dependabot
  alert closure must be confirmed after merge.
- Live SMB/server-family and installed-service upgrade/rollback qualification
  have not been performed for this release.

## Artifacts and checksums

Release assets:

- `ioc-extractor-0.2.1.jar`
- `ioc-extractor-0.2.1.jar.sha256`

```bash
sha256sum --check ioc-extractor-0.2.1.jar.sha256
```
